gloss: first half; first term; earlier period

definitions.gloss: first half; first term; first period
definitions.explanation: The first of two halves of a defined time span. Commonly used for academic semesters, fiscal periods, and historical eras.

examples.japanese: {前期|ぜんき}の{成績|せいせき}が{出|で}た。
examples.english: The grades for the first semester came out.

examples.japanese: {前期|ぜんき}の{売|う}り{上|あ}げは{好調|こうちょう}だった。
examples.english: Sales in the first half were strong.

examples.japanese: {江戸|えど}{時代|じだい}{前期|ぜんき}には{町人|ちょうにん}{文化|ぶんか}が{栄|さか}えた。
examples.english: In the early Edo period, merchant-class culture flourished.

notes:
Refers to the first of two halves of a time period. Commonly encountered in academic (semester), business (fiscal half), and historical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {前期|ぜんき}{試験|しけん}: first-semester exam
- {前期|ぜんき}{決算|けっさん}: first-half financial results
- {前期|ぜんき}{比|ひ}: compared to the previous period
- {前期|ぜんき}{課程|かてい}: first-term program (e.g., master's program in graduate school)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {後期|こうき}: second half, latter term — the counterpart of {前期|ぜんき}
- {上半期|かみはんき}: first half of the year (specifically January–June or April–September)
- {前半|ぜんはん}: first half (more general; used for games, events, etc.)
